thread.title: Could Apple Become A $1 Trillion Market Cap Stock In 2018?

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Could Apple Become A $1 Trillion Market Cap Stock In 2018?
text:
Apple ( AAPL ) started 2018 with a couple of bullish analyst reports, with one claiming the company is on path to become the first with a market value of $1 trillion this year.
X Drexel Hamilton analyst Brian White called Apple one of his top picks among hardware and software stocks for 2018 in a report Tuesday.
"Despite a strong performance in 2017, we believe Apple remains one of the most underappreciated stocks in the world," White said. "Moreover, we see plenty of catalysts for the stock to surpass the $1 trillion market capitalization mark in 2018 through further revaluation, heightened capital distribution opportunities, new innovations, a return to annual sales growth in Greater China and further progress in the ultra-luxury smartphone market."
White rates Apple stock as buy with a price target of 235.
Apple shares climbed 1.8% to close at 172.26 on the stock market today . It has a current market cap of about $877 billion. The stock reached a record high of 177.20 on Dec. 18.
